questions.question: The work done across two points having a potential difference of 10 V is 30 J. Then the electric charge flowing between the two points is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__3 Coulomb.__**

__
 
• **Work **is done when a force is applied on a body and makes a body move i.e. when the body displaces from its position by the act of force.
 
• For example- Pushing a car horizontally from a rest, Walking upstairs, Shooting a Bullet, etc. Its **S.I. Unit is Joule (J).**
 
• **Potential Difference **is the amount of work done by the positive test charge from one point to another point.
 
• For example- the movement of free electrons in a metallic conductor. Its **S.I. Unit is Volt (V).**
 
• **Electric charge **is the physical property of matter that causes it to experience a force when placed in an electromagnetic field.
 
• They are of two types: positive and negative. Its **S.I. unit is Coulomb (C).**

**​**

**Concept**__

** Work done= Potential Difference × Charge.**

__**Calculation:**​__

__
 
• **Work- 30 J,**
 
• **Potential difference- 10 V**
 
• **Charge- ?**

**​By Formula,**__

 
• ** Work = potential difference × charge **
 
• **Charge = work / potential difference**
 
• **Charge** =** 30 J / 10 V **
 
• **Charge** =** 3 Coulomb .**

Time taken by inlet B to fill the tank = 6 hours

⇒ Tank Remaining = 1 – 5/12 = 7/12

Let the cost price of textbook be 100x

⇒ SP = 100x – (15/100) × 100x = 85x

When sold at Rs. 150 higher there is a profit of 10%

⇒ SP = 100x + (10/100) × 100x = 110x

Now,

⇒ 110x – 85x = 150

⇒ 25x = 150

⇒ x = 6

⇒ 100x = Rs. 600

∴ Cost price of textbook is Rs. 600

**Alternative Method:**

Cost price × ((110/100) – (85/100)) = 150

⇒ Cost price × (25/100) = 150

After cross multiplying

⇒ Cost price = Rs. 600

questions.question: The difference between the selling prices of an article at profits 5% and 10% is Rs. 30. What will be the cost price of the article?

Selling price = (1 + (Profit%/100) × CP

**SOLUTION:**

SP when there is a profit of 10%

SP = 100x + (10/100) × 100x = 110x

SP when there is a profit of 5%

SP = 100x + (5/100) × 100x = 105x

According to the question,

Difference between the SPs is Rs. 30

110x – 105x = 30

⇒ 5x = 30

⇒ x = 6

⇒ 100x = 600

• On May 21, 2017, she made the **fastest double ascent of Mount Everest** and became the **first woman** to reach the **highest point on Earth twice in five days**.
 
• Anshu was the **brand Ambassador** of the **clean Indian Campaign** in the year **2012-2013**.
 
• She was nominated as the **brand ambassador of the North East Tourism**.

• **Bachendri Pal** is an Indian mountaineer. She is the **first Indian woman** to reach the **summit of Mount Everest in 1984**.

 
 
• She was **awarded by Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri.**
 
• **"EVEREST MY JOURNEY TO THE TOP"** book written by Bachendri Pal.
 
 
 
• **Premlata Agarwal** is an Indian mountaineer. She is the **first Indian woman** to have climbed the **Seven Summits or the seven highest peaks of the world**.
 
 
• She was conferred with the **Padma Shri** in the year **2013**.
 
• She is the winner of the **Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award**.
 
• **"Kar Vijay Har Shikhar"** written by Premlata Agarwal.
 
 
 
• **Arunima Sinha** is the world's first female amputee to scale Mount Everest, Mount Kilimanjaro (Tanzania), Mount Elbrus (Russia), Mount Kosciusko (Australia), Mount Aconcagua (South America), Mount Denali (North America) and Mount Vinson
 
 
• She was **trained by Bachendri Pal**.
 
• She was awarded **Padma Shri**.
 
• Arunima Sinha was honored **Amazing Indian Award** from **Vice President of India Shri M. Hamid Ansari on 6th February 2014**.
 
• **"Born Again on the Mountain: How I Lost Everything and Found It Back"** book is written by Arunima Sinha.
